commit.subject: LU-10026 ofd: avoid assertion on large read request
commit.message:
LU-10026 ofd: avoid assertion on large read request

In case an old client using CSDC sends a
read IO that will overflow buffers on OST, OST should
return an error rather than crash.

A similar check was previously added to the write path,
but was not added to the read path.

Test-Parameters: forjanitoronly
DDN-bug-id: EX-10359
Signed-off-by: Artem Blagodarenko <ablagodarenko@ddn.com>
Signed-off-by: Marc Vef <mvef@whamcloud.com>
